responses: Luffy first uses Gear 2 (Gear Second) in his fight against CP9 member Blueno. In the anime, this occurs in Episode 272. In the manga, it is introduced in Chapter 387. Gear 2 accelerates his blood flow using his rubber body, vastly increasing his speed and power.

Luffy's Gear 3 (Gear Third) is first teased in Episode 273 (manga Chapter 388) and fully revealed in his fight against Rob Lucci in Episode 288 (manga Chapter 403). Gear 3 involves Luffy biting his thumb and blowing air directly into his bones, making his limbs giant to deliver massive, heavy attacks.

Luffy reveals Gear 4 (Gear Fourth - Boundman) during his battle against Donquixote Doflamingo in Dressrosa. In the anime, this happens in Episode 726 (manga Chapter 784). He later reveals other forms: Tankman (Episode 806) and Snakeman (Episode 870 during his fight with Katakuri). Gear 4 coats his inflated muscles in Armament Haki.

Luffy unlocks Gear 5 (Gear Fifth), the awakening of his Devil Fruit, during the climax of his battle against Kaido on Onigashima. In the anime, it debuts in Episode 1071 (manga Chapter 1044). In this form, Luffy represents the Warrior of Liberation, Sun God Nika, allowing him to fight with complete freedom, cartoonish physics, and turning his surroundings into rubber.

The final fight between Luffy and Doflamingo occurs in the Dressrosa Arc. In the anime, the battle starts around Episode 721, and Luffy officially defeats Doflamingo using Gear 4 King Kong Gun in Episode 733 (manga Chapter 790).

Luffy's legendary duel against Charlotte Katakuri takes place in Mirror World during the Whole Cake Island Arc. The battle spans from Episode 850 to Episode 871. Luffy defeats Katakuri using his new Gear 4 Snakeman form in Episode 871 (manga Chapter 896).

Luffy and Kaido fight multiple times on Onigashima in the Wano Arc. The final round begins in Episode 1049, Luffy unlocks Gear 5 in Episode 1071, and he ultimately defeats Kaido with his Bajrang Gun in Episode 1076 (manga Chapter 1049).

patterns: What episode does Ace die in?
responses: Portgas D. Ace is tragically killed by Admiral Akainu while protecting Luffy during the Battle of Marineford. In the anime, Ace dies in Episode 483 (manga Chapter 574).

patterns: Start of Great Pirate Era episode
responses: Gol D. Roger was executed in Loguetown. In the anime, his execution and final words are shown in Episode 1 and revisited in flashback episodes like Episode 48 and Episode 968 (which shows his final voyage).
